notes.title: Less Rage Update - 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Less Rage Update![/h2]
Craterbound has definitely had a bit of a rocky start, with many of our players understandably not knowing how to start the game, find bosses, defeat the tanks, etc. Craterbound's first major update serves to fix these issues and to rebalance early game combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41716820/aa95c217f9a1cf81d277ecb929af576986fd39c3.png[/img]
[h3]Tank Changes[/h3]
Tanks have been the bane of many player's existence, including myself. Thankfully, they have been changed for the better:
[list]
[*] [b]Tanks can now be killed without crafting expensive EMPs[/b]
[*] Tanks can be killed by attacking them several times with your stun pistol, the amount of times is dependent on game difficulty (2/4/5)
[*] To balance this, tanks are now stunned for less time, dependent on the game difficulty (1.25/1.0/0.75)
[*] Tank random resource amount range has been increased.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41716820/a52bbbfd457a7d7353a2c9d86b11466d90d343be.png[/img]
[h3]Quality of Life Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bosses can be found on the tablet's map through the skull icons[/b]
[*] [b]Fabricators now have item descriptions so that you know what you're fabricating[/b]
[*] Multitool laser now lines up with crosshair
[*] [b]Added loading screen[/b]
[*] Enemies repopulate faster, giving less time where there are no enemies around
[*] Added FOV and Invert Mouse settings
[*] Copper asteroid fragments now spawn closer to impact and give more resources
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41716820/f894650153639bdc25b247a8df0244129f0ed2fa.png[/img]
[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed players on slow computers falling through the map[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed bug where players' sensitivities would default to zero[/b]
[*] Rocks/Enemies should no longer spawn on bases or trees
[*] Rocks no longer float mid-air
[*] Enemies will no longer spawn on unwalkable slopes
[*] Compass direction now lines up with tablet map
[/list]

In summary, I hope this update provides many of the changes to Craterbound you all were hoping to see, and allows many of you to have a more fun and enjoyable gameplay experience. Make sure to stay tuned for what's coming next and let us know what changes you want to see added to the game! As always, if you ever need any help or have suggestions, please reach out through the [url=https://discord.gg/BVmjWXfkUW]Official Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Tank Refactor and QoL
notes.content:
Welcome back Craternauts, I believe following this update many of you will find Craterbound much easier to play.

Tank Changes:
[list]
[*] Tanks are now killable without EMPs. The player must shoot the tank until blue stun particles appear around the tank. Shooting/hitting the tank one more time after that will shatter it and allow it to be mined.
[*] EMPs will immediately shatter Tanks, and are still overpowered in killing them.
[*] Tanks are now stunned for much less time when stunned.
[/list]

Quality of Life Changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Added loading screen[/b]
[*] [b]Fabricator now has item descriptions[/b]
[*] Fixed players on slow computers sometimes falling through the world on map load
[*] Compass direction now lines up with tablet map direction
[*] Rocks should no longer float, or spawn on bases/trees
[*] Enemies should no longer spawn on trees or on slopes which are too steep to walk on
[*] Enemy spawn timer should be increased, less long waits for repopulation
[*] Fixed sensitivity defaulting to zero
[*] Added FOV setting
[*] Made multitool line up with crosshair
[/list]

[i]And a few other changes...[/i]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Suggestions + QoL Patch
notes.content:
QoL Balance Updates:
- Made laser tanks not spawn until players are capable of defending themselves with EMPs
- Made laser tank chase radius much more reasonable
- Made laser tanks stunnable for more times and for longer before resistance is gained

Options Updates:
- Sensitivity Slider Option Added
- Moved V-Sync and Colorblindness options to video options panel
